svg.title: A pine bonsai in the snow: 256 contributions this year, a 2 day streak, 34 in the last 7 days.
svg.desc: A snow covered pine bonsai in a glazed pot on a winter night, with warm fairy lights, falling snow and a stone lantern. Drawn from the GitHub history of zainkhalid91 on 2026-11-28.

g.text: Redrawn every night from my GitHub.
